name: @layoutit/polycss-domformat
description: Private deterministic retained-DOM JSON format for PolyCSS prepared models.

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run build && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run check && npm run build && node --import tsx --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="src/**/*.ts" --test-coverage-lines=90 --test-coverage-branches=85 --test-coverage-functions=90 --test test/*.test.js
scripts.test:page-preparation: node --import tsx scripts/check-page-preparation.js && node --import tsx scripts/check-publication-performance.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && node --check conformance/viewer/*.js && node --check scripts/*.js && node --check viewer/*.js
scripts.conformance: python3 -B conformance/run_corpus.py && python3 -B conformance/check_canonical.py && python3 -B conformance/check_css.py
scripts.test:release: npm run check:nversion && npm test && npm run conformance && npm run test:browser && npm run test:page-preparation && npm run pack:check
